'''Revelation He will come to you, and you will bring him before me.''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 26 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif|label=Bring Him Before Me}}
* '''Strategy:''' Bring Him Before Me
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 BHBM Revelation DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Yes, my master.

The published list has 69 cards.

== Strategy ==

If you can't tell, this is a beatdown deck. I don't think there will be much trouble getting cards under Insignificant Rebellion. And about what everyone says: I don't HAVE Emperor Palpatine, so The Emperor will have to do. Besides that, I think I have a pretty balanced and good deck. What about you? spideyguy0: I took out all the starships. I didn't need them. I guess we just have different defensive worries. karrde: I generate seven force even if Don't Do That Again hits the table. That's enough to deploy any of my characters if you count the location -bonuses. And I have this really neat trick called NOT DRAWING UP MY ENTIRE FORCE PILE SO I'LL HAVE SOME LEFT OVER NEXT TURN.
